history.title: Our History
history.description: The Akhil Bharatiya Goswami Sabha has been serving the Goswami community for decades, working towards the social, cultural, and economic upliftment of our community members.

goswami.title: The Goswami Samaj
goswami.subtitle: Also known as the Dashnami Gosavi or Gosai community
goswami.intro: The Goswami Samaj is a distinguished community with deep roots in Indian spiritual and monastic traditions.

etymology.title: Etymology & Meaning
etymology.goswamiDesc: Signifies someone who has mastered and controlled their senses

origin.title: Origins & The Ten Orders
origin.description: Adi Shankaracharya established four primary mathas (monasteries) across India and appointed disciples whose lineages formed ten distinct names (Dashnami), representing different paths of asceticism and scholarship.

tenOrders.title: Ten Orders (Dashnami)
tenOrders.description: Members of the Goswami community belong to ten distinct monastic sub-traditions, each bearing a unique name:
tenOrders.orders: Giri, Puri, Bharti, Ban, Aranya, Sagar, Aashram, Saraswati, Tirth, and Parwat/Yogi
tenOrders.note: These ten names (Dashnami) represent the diverse branches of the monastic order established by Adi Shankaracharya, each preserving unique traditions while sharing a common spiritual foundation.

divisions.title: Lifestyle Divisions
divisions.description: The Goswami community traditionally comprises two main lifestyle divisions:

mathdhari.title: Mathdhari
mathdhari.description: Monastery dwellers who dedicate their lives to spiritual practice, scholarship, and the preservation of ancient knowledge.

gharbari.title: Gharbari
gharbari.description: Householders who live within society, many of whom serve as family priests (purohits), teachers (gurus), and community leaders — carrying forward the spiritual traditions into everyday life.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To unite the Goswami community, preserve our cultural heritage, promote education, and create opportunities for the holistic development of every member.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: A progressive, empowered, and united Goswami community that contributes meaningfully to nation-building while preserving its rich cultural traditions.

leadership.title: Our Leadership
leadership.description: Meet the dedicated leaders who guide our organization
